items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: That's when Thomas Ridley was singing the band at the Pelican.

ctx.x: I thought he might have been here for a half a year or several months.

Oh, no sir. No sir. He'd be here for about three or four weeks or something like that. Sometimes you have a holdover, you know, and the people like him so much, well, they'd hold him over for another week or something like that. Then you had this boy, Walnut Harris. He'd work under me too at Dew Drop. We had Lil Miss Cornchuck. Remember her? Yeah. We recorded her at the J&M. Yeah. We recorded her. I recorded her the day when I was at the Pelican when we opened up the Pelican. Yeah. That's when Thomas Ridley was…
I'm trying to think, is that originally any relation to the old time trombone?
